# Paged.js 0.4.3

Unmodified `dist/paged.js` from the published `pagedjs@0.4.3` package.
Source: https://unpkg.com/pagedjs@0.4.3/dist/paged.js
Project: https://pagedjs.org/ and https://github.com/pagedjs/pagedjs
License: MIT; see LICENSE.md and the distribution's license header.

Used only inside the isolated `typografie-lesedruck.html` document. No automatic
polyfill on the atelier page and no runtime requests to a third-party CDN.
